articles.title: A $1.8 Billion Fight Over a New Top Lawyer!
articles.summary: President Trump wants Todd Blanche as Attorney General, but two senators say no because of a huge fund for people who feel wronged by courts. Trump called the fund 'dead'—then changed his mind! The vote is Tuesday.

articles.title: Rapper Freed from Prison After 18 Days—But His Fight Isn't Over!
articles.summary: Moroccan rapper Mehdi El Youbi, known as Mehdi Black Wind, was let out of prison in Casablanca after being held for 'insulting a constitutional institution.' He still faces a trial in October and could get up to two years in prison.

articles.title: Soccer Boss in Big Trouble! Two Giant Groups Demand a 'Full Review'
articles.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino is under fire after a plan to sell parts of soccer tournaments to investors was dropped. UEFA and Concacaf say he broke promises and want a review of his leadership. He's up for re-election in March.
